entities.summary: Rafael Spregelburd is an Argentine playwright, director and actor. He studied acting and drama at the University of Buenos Aires. From 1995 he started directing, mainly in theatre performances of his own works. He won a number of awards including the Tirso de Molina. His plays are critically acclaimed in Argentina and in some European countries.
